_comment: PRODUCT CONFIG: same-night >=3-DETECTION CONFIRMATION tier. Purity comes from GEOMETRY across >=3 epochs (the (FP)^N collapse: lambda_3v=0/night at S>=0.8; 0.0575 at 0.6 -- link_fpp_calib_3visit.json; 2v->3v promotion measured 33% of true 2v promoted, 0 false), so the score floor is RELAXED below the 2v tiers and the photometric mfsnr cut is DROPPED. Cadence-limited at WFD (>=3 same-night visits rare by design) but big at deep-drilling/dense cadence. Output = high-confidence discovery CANDIDATE (still same-night short-arc: orbit is not determined; multi-night or follow-up seals it).
model_version: seg_v2 depth-4 (iter08) segmentation + focal-cutout CNN postproc
calibrated_on: null-MC FPP calibration link_fpp_calib_3visit.json (lambda_3v vs S); promotion validation on 82 injection fields
notes: score_min=0.70 (not lower) because lambda_3v at 0.6 is 0.0575/night (nonzero) and 0.0025 at 0.7 -- 0.70 keeps the tier FAR-clean while gaining recall over 0.80. mfsnr_min_2v=0 (disabled): the 2v photometric cut costs ~2.5x faint-fast completeness and 3v geometry replaces its purity role. 3v-FIRST SEEDING (seed_3v_arc_min=180): chord pairs are ALSO seeded in a wide 3h window and used ONLY to extend to triplets (gated by the 3-epoch linear-RMS/PA/speed checks, NEVER the 2v alert gates) -- a mover with no pair inside the 40-min 2v window (e.g. visits 0/50/100 min) is still found. Structural note: promotion has always run on UNGATED chord pairs, so 3v candidates never required a passing 2v parent; the wide window closes the remaining arc-coverage gap.
